name: 98040 · Mercer Island, WA
findings: ZIP 98040 (Mercer Island) has 149 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98040 (Mercer Island) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 24 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
